CPU: Dual AMD EPYC™ 7003/7002 Series Processors (7003 Series Processor drop-in support requires BIOS version 2.0 or newer)

Memory Capacity: Supports up to 4TB Registered ECC DDR4 3200MHz SDRAM in 16 DIMMs
For Dual CPUs: Recommended that memory be populated equally in adjacent memory banks
Memory Type: DDR4 3200 MHz Registered ECC, 288-pin gold-plated DIMMs

IPMI: Support for Intelligent Platform Management Interface v. 2.0
IPMI 2.0 with virtual media over LAN and KVM-over-LAN support
Network Controllers: 1 PCI-E 4.0 x16 SIOM LAN Networking Slot

PCI-Express: 1 PCI-E 4.0 x24 Proprietary Slot (for Supermicro storage add-on card)
1 PCI-E 4.0 x16 SIOM LAN Networking Slot

Power Configurations: Power-on mode control for AC power loss recovery
